newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weaker on recent crude fall.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weaker on recent crude fall.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Thursday.
Gasoline edged lower, pulled down by two consecutive days of falls on NYMEX futures.
Naphtha was slightly weaker, but paraffinic supply was still tight as Algeria's Skikda port remained shut due to bad weather
Gas oil prices slipped in concert with a $.150 fall on IPE futures, but premiums for low sulphur diesel remained firm on tight supplies.
Fuel oil was softer in line with easier crude. High sulphur barges traded $3 down, settling in a $123-124 fob ARA range.
